display_long_description:
Turn your living room into a cozy, zero-mess woodworking studio!

SnapWood MR: Cozy Craft & 3D Puzzle brings the deeply satisfying art of 3D woodcraft and spatial joinery straight onto your real-world table.

A glowing holographic blueprint appears right in front of you. Using just your bare hands, pick up warm, handcrafted wooden blocks, rotate them in mid-air, and feel the satisfying click as every piece snaps perfectly into place.

KEY FEATURES:

100% Controller-Free Hand Tracking: Put down the controllers! Pinch, grab, rotate, and assemble naturally with your own hands. Designed natively for Quest 3 & 3S full-color passthrough.

Tactile ASMR Satisfaction: Enjoy realistic wood textures, crisp snap-fit mechanics, and soothing wood-tapping spatial audio.

Brain-Teasing 3D Blueprints: Progress from cozy tabletop chairs and everyday furniture to intricate architectural sculptures that challenge your spatial IQ.

Pure Cozy Zen: No timers, no pressure, no sawdust. Play comfortably seated at your desk or couch while enjoying your morning coffee.

Perfect for fans of spatial 3D puzzles, tabletop building, DIY woodcraft, and relaxing Mixed Reality experiences. Ready to snap your first masterpiece together?
